name: tapered tower
caption: A tapered tower with a wide base, narrowing walls and a pointed crown. A continuous wall rises from a wide base; a narrowing crown caps the top. Circular walls keep an even thickness up to the crown. Overall width is 0.80 times depth; height is 2.80 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous light gray, charcoal, tan color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
